reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already decides missing/number/range with the worst-case rule, on the raw _amount.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the expected amount is fully delegated to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in the api/schedules-get handler with a dedicated list type rather than in scheduleModel.toExternal, which keeps it list-only as requested but splits the external shape across the model and the handler.

scope.why: Only the handler, its return type and a test change.

maintainability.why: Small and explicit, with a typed list entity; a maintainer adding other schedule-returning endpoints must remember the field lives in the handler.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getScheduledAmount from #shared/schedules and wraps scheduleModel.toExternal.
